description: This PHP source file defines the ConfiguratorViewAddFontResult class, which handles the upload and processing of font files in the SuiteCRM application's configurator module. It checks user permissions, manages file uploads, interacts with the FontManager to add fonts, and renders the result template.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewAddFontResult
classes.description: A view class that manages the font upload process and displays the success or error message in the SuiteCRM configurator module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the result after attempting to add a font; checks admin permissions, calls addFont(), and renders the template.

methods.name: addFont
methods.description: Handles the font file uploads, interacts with FontManager to add the font, and logs success or errors.
